mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RechargeRecordDEMS(StudentId, Amount, Type, OperatorId) VALUES(#{studentId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT rr.*, s.StudentName, CASE WHEN rr.Type = 1 THEN a.AdminName ELSE st.StaffName END as OperatorName FROM RechargeRecordDEMS rr LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON rr.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN AdminDEMS a ON rr.Type = 1 AND rr.OperatorId = a.AdminId LEFT JOIN StaffDEMS st ON rr.Type = 0 AND rr.OperatorId = st.StaffId WHERE rr.StudentId = #{studentId} ORDER BY rr.CreateTime DESC

SELECT rr.*, s.StudentName, CASE WHEN rr.Type = 1 THEN a.AdminName ELSE st.StaffName END as OperatorName FROM RechargeRecordDEMS rr LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON rr.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN AdminDEMS a ON rr.Type = 1 AND rr.OperatorId = a.AdminId LEFT JOIN StaffDEMS st ON rr.Type = 0 AND rr.OperatorId = st.StaffId WHERE rr.CreateTime BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY rr.CreateTime DESC

SELECT rr.*, s.StudentName, CASE WHEN rr.Type = 1 THEN a.AdminName ELSE st.StaffName END as OperatorName FROM RechargeRecordDEMS rr LEFT JOIN StudentDEMS s ON rr.StudentId = s.StudentId LEFT JOIN AdminDEMS a ON rr.Type = 1 AND rr.OperatorId = a.AdminId LEFT JOIN StaffDEMS st ON rr.Type = 0 AND rr.OperatorId = st.StaffId WHERE 1=1 AND rr.StudentId LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentId}, '%') AND ( a.AdminName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operatorId}, '%') OR st.StaffName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operatorId}, '%') ) AND rr.CreateTime >= #{startDate} AND rr.CreateTime <= #{endDate} ORDER BY rr.CreateTime DESC
